mcp.server: Label before the name of the connected MCP server.
mcp.notLoaded: Shown in place of the server name before the tools have been loaded.
mcp.load: Button that loads the tools, resources and prompts of the MCP server. Short.
mcp.reload: Button that loads them again. Short.
mcp.signIn: Button that starts the OAuth sign-in to an MCP server.
mcp.signingIn: Label of the sign-in button while the sign-in runs.
mcp.serverProtocol: {{version}} is a protocol version date. MCP is the Model Context Protocol and stays in English.
mcp.instructions: Button that shows text the MCP server provides for the models that use it.
mcp.operation: Accessible label of the picker for the MCP operation to run.
mcp.operations.toolsCall: Operation: run one tool of the server.
mcp.operations.resourceTemplatesList: Operation: list the resource templates (address patterns with parameters).
mcp.itemLabels.tool: Accessible label of the tool name field.
mcp.itemLabels.resource: Accessible label of the resource address field. URI is a standard term.
mcp.itemLabels.prompt: Accessible label of the prompt name field.
mcp.choose.tool: First option of the tool picker.
mcp.choose.prompt: First option of the prompt picker.
mcp.schema: Button that shows the JSON Schema of the arguments next to the editor.
mcp.closeSchema: Accessible label of the button that closes the schema pane.
mcp.example: Button that fills the arguments with a generated example. Short.
mcp.checks: Button that shows problems found in the tool definitions. A number follows the label.
mcp.findings: Messages about the quality of the tool definitions of an MCP server. {{tool}} is a tool name.
mcp.findings.invalidName: Keep the characters _ - and . as given.
mcp.schemaProblems: Short clauses inserted into the sentence "the input schema is not usable". They start in lower case.
mcp.changes.added: {{names}} is a list of tool names.
mcp.changes.removed: {{names}} is a list of tool names.
mcp.changes.before: Label of the previous description of a tool.
mcp.changes.now: Label of the current description of a tool.
mcp.changes.noDescription: Shown in place of an empty description.
mcp.auth.title: Heading of the list of sign-in steps.
mcp.auth.steps: Names of the steps of the MCP OAuth sign-in, shown in a list. RFC numbers stay as given.
mcp.auth.outcomes: Result of one sign-in step. Short.
mcp.auth.explanations: Explanations of sign-in problems. Words in code font such as resource_metadata, iss or S256 are technical names and stay in English.
mcp.auth.attempts: Accessible label of the list of addresses that were requested.
mcp.notifications: Summary of a collapsible list of notifications from the server. {{count}} is their number.
mcp.notificationTime: {{milliseconds}} is a number of milliseconds since the request started. Keep ms.
mcp.progressOf: {{progress}} out of {{total}} for a progress notification.
mcp.catalogHints.remote: {{example}} is a command line and stays as given.
mcp.catalogHints.local: Local servers are programs started on this computer. Headers tab is an interface label.
mcp.promptArgumentRequired: {{name}} is the name of a prompt argument.
mcp.promptArgumentDescribed: {{label}} is an argument name, possibly followed by (required); {{description}} is its description.
mcp.media.image: {{number}} is the position of the image in the result, starting at 1.
mcp.media.audio: {{number}} is the position of the audio clip in the result, starting at 1.
mcpOutput.name: Name of an automatic check that compares the structured result of an MCP tool with the output schema the tool declares.
mcp.issuerDetail: Technical detail under a sign-in problem. {{expected}} and {{received}} are issuer addresses (URLs) and stay unchanged.
mcp.auth.close: Button that closes the sign-in progress dialog. Verb.
